title: Swift test baselineCreateRefusesToOverwriteAndUpdateDoes is flaky on CI
notes: 2026-11-23: failed once on main at 01887cb5 (CheckCommandTests.swift:50-52, all three runBinary statuses wrong), passed on the re-run and on the previous commit with identical Swift sources and Package.resolved. Likely a race between tests that spawn the built binary against a shared fixture or build product.
done_when: The cause is identified and the test passes 20 consecutive runs, or it is shown to be runner noise.
result: Swift test baselineCreateRefusesToOverwriteAndUpdateDoes is flaky on CI
